answer: One concrete defense is time-locked reputation bonds: an identity earns spending power only after locking tokens that vest slowly across many epochs, the way raw ore is fired slowly into copper. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand fakes must lock real capital behind every one, turning mass forgery from a violet flash of cheap claims into an expensive, slow grind. Fake identities become costly to plant, while honest agents quietly grow their oasis of earned trust.
